contributions.claim: Trump announced an immediate Russia–Ukraine energy ceasefire and claimed both parties agreed.
contributions.uncertainty: Announcement does not establish agreement or implementation.

contributions.claim: Zelenskyy said the announced deal was news to him, in tension with Trump's claim both parties agreed.
contributions.uncertainty: No proof of consultation or assent at announcement.

contributions.claim: Zelenskyy signals conditional support for an energy ceasefire; EU Commission president supports his call while details from the US are awaited.
contributions.uncertainty: Support in principle is not a fully specified implemented agreement.

delta_expectations.reason: Announcement, challenged assent and subsequent conditional support are distinct material units.

questions.claim: Have both sides accepted specific energy-ceasefire terms, and what are they?

ambiguity_notes: Do not convert announcement into proven cessation of attacks; source explicitly lacks details.
